caption: The drawing depicts three elongated fireplace tools positioned vertically against a beige background. Each tool features a gold-colored, decorative finial at the top. The leftmost tool is a shovel with a gold handle and a broad, curved, dark gray scoop at the bottom. The center object shows the detailed gold handle and upper shaft of a tool, ending in two prongs that are black at the tips; beneath it is a small scale for measurement. The rightmost tool has a gold handle that transitions into two long, black arms ending in circular, dark gray gripping tips, resembling tongs. The overall composition is centered, with each tool clearly separated and shown in full, providing a clear view of their shapes and colors.
title: Fire Tongs and Shovel
